items.jp: 何か意味があるのだろうか。

translation.pt-BR: Será que isso tem algum significado?
translation.en: Does that mean something?

items.label: nominalizer (准体助詞)
items.explanation: の turns the clause 意味がある into a nominal block, allowing だろうか to be attached (it is the の of のだろうか, which gives a nuance of explanation/reflection).

items.jp: 病気だときいたので。

translation.pt-BR: Soube que você estava doente.
translation.en: I've heard you've been sick.

items.label: nominalizer, forming ので together with で
items.explanation: this の combines with the following で to form the conjunction 〜ので ('because/since'), which presents the reason for something in a softer and more objective way than から.

items.jp: 病気で動かれなくなったのではないかな。

translation.pt-BR: Será que ela não acabou ficando impossibilitada de se mover por causa de uma doença?
translation.en: I wonder if she might not have become unable to move because of an illness.

items.label: nominalizer (nominalizing の)
items.explanation: の turns the whole clause 動かれなくなった into a nominal unit ('the fact of having become unable to move'), so that ではないか can act on it.
tokens: negation auxiliary (part of ではないか)

items.jp: それでどうなったの

items.label: sentence-final question particle (informal)

items.label: quotative particle (casual)
items.explanation: って is the colloquial form of という/と and 'wraps' 忙しい as the content of the impression, linking it to 感じ.

items.jp: 具合が悪かったんだってね。

translation.pt-BR: Soube que você não estava se sentindo bem.
translation.en: I heard you were sick.

items.label: って de boato ('dizem que')
items.explanation: って marca a informação como algo que chegou de fora: quem fala soube por terceiros que a pessoa passou mal.

items.jp: 弟さんって、お幾つですか？

translation.pt-BR: Quantos anos tem o seu irmão mais novo?
translation.en: How old is your brother?

items.label: colloquial topic marker
items.explanation: って is an informal version of は/というのは: it introduces 弟さん as the topic of the question ('speaking of your brother...'); common in everyday speech.

items.jp: お米１合って何グラム？

translation.pt-BR: Um 'go' de arroz dá quantos gramas?
translation.en: How many grams is one 'go' of rice?

items.label: colloquial topicalizing/quotative particle (って)
items.explanation: Spoken, informal version of は (or of というのは); it picks up 'お米一合' and sets it as the theme: 'this thing of one go of rice, how many grams is it?'.

items.jp: タバコを吸うのって、これが初めて。

translation.pt-BR: É a primeira vez que eu fumo.
translation.en: This is the first time I've smoked.

items.label: colloquial topic marker
items.explanation: って is an informal version of は/というのは, presenting 'this smoking thing' as the topic of the sentence.

items.jp: 日曜って、空いてる？

translation.pt-BR: No domingo, você tá livre?
translation.en: Are you free on Sunday?

items.label: colloquial topic marker
items.explanation: って põe 日曜 como assunto no registro falado, fazendo o papel que o は faria: e no domingo, como fica?

items.jp: 明日は雪になるんだって。

translation.pt-BR: Ouvi dizer que amanhã vai nevar.
translation.en: I heard that it's going to snow tomorrow.

items.label: って de boato ('dizem que')
items.explanation: って fecha a frase e marca tudo como coisa ouvida de outra pessoa: quem fala não viu a previsão, escutou.

items.jp: 誰にだって、感情ってものがある。

translation.pt-BR: Todo mundo tem sentimentos.
translation.en: We all have feelings.

items.label: partícula de reforço, dentro de 誰にだって
items.explanation: Este って fecha 誰にだ e forma 誰にだって, o jeito coloquial de dizer 'seja para quem for'. Ele estende a afirmação a qualquer pessoa.

items.jp: 男子ってよく分かんないや。

translation.pt-BR: Eu não entendo os garotos.
translation.en: I don't know anything about boys.

items.label: colloquial topic marker
items.explanation: って põe 男子 como assunto no lugar de は, com o tom de desabafo da conversa.

items.jp: これってデートなの？

translation.pt-BR: Isso aqui é um encontro?
translation.en: Is this a date?

items.label: colloquial topic marker
items.explanation: って põe これ como assunto no registro falado, no lugar de は: 'isso aqui é um encontro?'.

items.jp: 残念な知らせって何？

translation.pt-BR: Qual é a má notícia?
translation.en: What is the bad news?

items.label: colloquial topic marker
items.explanation: って põe 残念な知らせ como assunto e pede que digam qual é, no registro da conversa.

items.jp: どんなに遅くなっても起こしてください。

translation.pt-BR: Por mais tarde que fique, me acorde, por favor.
translation.en: However late you may be, be sure to wake me.

items.label: connective particle (links to the request form)
items.explanation: て links 起こす to ください, forming the polite request structure 起こしてください.
tokens: concessive adverb (forms どんなに with に)
element that turns どんな into the adverb どんなに

items.jp: 試合はラジオでも放送している

translation.pt-BR: O jogo está sendo transmitido também pelo rádio.
translation.en: The game is also being broadcast on the radio.

items.label: means/instrument marker ('by/through')
items.explanation: で indicates the medium through which the broadcast happens: 'on the radio'.
tokens: nominal head of the compound verb

items.jp: 全部で九つになった

translation.pt-BR: No total, ficaram nove.
translation.en: In total, there were nine.

items.label: particle of aggregation/total
items.explanation: で in 全部で sums up the entire set, giving the sense 'in total / altogether'.

items.jp: 国際問題は戦争ではなく外交で解決されなければならない。

translation.pt-BR: Problemas internacionais têm que ser resolvidos pela diplomacia, não pela guerra.
translation.en: International problems must be solved by diplomacy, not war.

items.label: particle of means/instrument
items.explanation: Este で marca 戦争 como o meio que se descarta; com はなく logo depois, ele monta o 'não pela guerra'.

items.jp: 学校まで１０分で歩いて行ける。

translation.pt-BR: Dá para ir a pé até a escola em 10 minutos.
translation.en: I can walk to school in 10 minutes.

items.label: deadline/means marker
items.explanation: で here indicates the period within which the action is completed: 'in 10 minutes'.

items.jp: 美人でもある。

translation.pt-BR: Ela também é bonita.
translation.en: She's also a beauty.

items.label: linking form of the copula だ (te-form)
items.explanation: This 「で」 is the linking form of 「だ」 ('to be'); it links the noun 「美人」 to the rest and, together with 「も」, forms 「でもある」.

items.jp: 友達と花見に行きたい

translation.pt-BR: Quero ir ver as cerejeiras com os amigos.
translation.en: I want to go see the cherry blossoms with my friends.

items.label: marks accompaniment (with whom)
items.explanation: と links 友達 to the verb indicating that the action is done in the company of friends ('with friends').

items.jp: 戦争はもう二度としたくない

translation.pt-BR: Não quero guerra nunca mais.
translation.en: I never want war again.

items.label: particle closing the adverbial expression 二度と
items.explanation: Here と is part of the set phrase 二度と ('a second time', used with a negative = 'never again'). It is not the と of citation nor the と of 'and/with'; it crystallizes 二度 into an emphatic adverb that requires a negative predicate.
tokens: counter (part of 二度と 'twice / never again')

items.jp: 彼は忙しいとみえて、返事が来ない

translation.pt-BR: Pelo visto ele está ocupado, e por isso não responde.
translation.en: He seems busy, since he's not replying.

items.label: quotative particle
items.explanation: と quotes 忙しい as the concluded content; it is the obligatory と of the とみえる pattern.

items.jp: スイッチを押すと火が点く

translation.pt-BR: Quando você aperta o interruptor, o fogo acende.
translation.en: When you press the switch, the flame lights up.

items.label: conditional 'when/whenever'
items.explanation: と after the dictionary form indicates an automatic consequence: whenever the condition (pressing) occurs, the result (the fire lighting) happens.

items.jp: 彼が来ないと困ります

translation.pt-BR: Se ele não vier, vai ser um problema.
translation.en: If he doesn't come, it'll be a problem.

items.label: conditional connector
items.explanation: と forms the conditional: it links 'if he doesn't come' to the consequence 'I get into trouble'; the ないと pattern indicates something necessary.

items.jp: 留学生と友だちになりました

translation.pt-BR: Fiquei amigo de um estudante de intercâmbio.
translation.en: I became friends with an exchange student.

items.label: accompaniment particle / partner in the action
items.explanation: と here marks with whom someone becomes friends. In 'A と 友だち に なる', と indicates the person with whom the bond is formed, like 'with' in 'to become friends with someone'.

items.jp: いつも勝てるとは限らないよ。

translation.pt-BR: Você nem sempre vai ganhar.
translation.en: You can't always win.

items.label: quotative particle
items.explanation: と quotes the content 勝てる ('that one can win') as that to which the sentence is not 'limited.'

items.jp: 彼は弟と間違えられた。

translation.pt-BR: Ele foi confundido com o irmão mais novo.
translation.en: He was mistaken for his younger brother.

items.label: accompaniment/comparison marker
items.explanation: と indicates the person he was mistaken for (弟と = with the younger brother), the typical role of と with verbs of confusing/comparing.
tokens: term of comparison (who one was mistaken for)

items.jp: 彼は町の人みんなと付き合いがあった。

translation.pt-BR: Ele tinha contato com todo mundo da cidade.
translation.en: He was acquainted with everybody in town.

items.label: companionship particle
items.explanation: と marca 町の人みんな como o outro lado da relação: era com todo mundo da cidade que ele tinha contato.

items.jp: 彼は知事と長年の付き合いです。

translation.pt-BR: Ele conhece o governador há muitos anos.
translation.en: He is the governor's longtime companion.

items.label: accompaniment particle ('with')
items.explanation: と marca 知事 como a outra parte da convivência: é com o governador que ele tem esses longos anos.

items.jp: 彼は私と同様若くない。

translation.pt-BR: Ele, assim como eu, já não é jovem.
translation.en: He is not young any more than I am.

items.label: と de comparação (〜と同様)
items.explanation: と marca 私 como o termo de comparação de 同様: ele está na mesma situação de quem fala.
